method.lineVerify: streamed all 16 official v3 jsonl; every line sha256/offset/bytes vs matching -index.json; seed formula vs full-sim-seeds.json; uniqueness; unfinished phases; command.ok; contribution sum vs spin income; per-spin bySource vs spin.income. Process exit 0 and progress.done are not acceptance.
method.replay: fullNewRun(seed) then fullCommand each recorded action with live revision; final JSON SHA vs recorded finalHash. Not a Greedy policy re-run.
method.replaySelection: all 8 games with index===0 (one per bot/split in *-0 shards); first record of each of 16 files (8 of those are index 0, 8 are index 500); plus 8 extra index===1 games (one per bot/split). 24 unique command replays.
method.income: all 8000 games contribution sum == sum(spin.income); plus one index-0 game per bot reported; plus per-spin bySource.
method.isolation: publicView deletes rng+seed; policyRng independent of five game streams; Greedy surrogate seed full-sim-model-v1/0; train/holdout exact seed strings disjoint.
method.wilson: stats.js source inspection; rate() Wilson only on independent game/seed trials; ratio() without lo/hi for offer/event/acquisition-event.
